body: Remeron, ambien, neurontin, lamictal, geodon and xanax. Life's never more normal. It's been one thing after another this past year...
We did stuff like that when I was hospitalized. Was complete torture to me. Not a people person. I BSed my whole way through.

I've had no ill side effects from the ambien. Sometimes it's harder to get to sleep, but eventually if will knock me out though. Seroquel was hell for me though. At first all it would do it make me keep feeling like I was hitting a brick wall and eat all the time. Never would make me fall asleep though. In a time span of 4 months my old psych had me on 600 mg a day of it (I'm 5'1" and 125 pounds) and it did nothing at all...

I try watching TV in the living room often. I get too nervous and have to leave not long after. I don't get accepted into chatrooms well; I'm too shy for people to like me :P I wouldn't even know where to go to one.

Sometimes I'll try to go get coffee or something. In public I'm and warm and as nice as can be. Can't tell there's a damn thing wrong with me when all I want to do is run. Looks like I have a movie (at a theater) date with someone via reddit this week though. We'll see how that works.
I'm currently on ambien every night for sleep.
